questions.text: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error: Neither of the two candidates have submitted their documents before the deadline.

questions.text: According to the passage, how many tiger reserves were initially established when Project Tiger was launched in 1973?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly states that only nine tiger reserves were established in 1973.
questions.passage: In 1973, India launched Project Tiger to protect the dwindling population of Bengal tigers and preserve their natural forest habitats. At the time of its launch, only nine tiger reserves were established across the country, covering roughly 18,278 square kilometres. Over the past five decades, strict anti-poaching measures, scientific habitat restoration, and active participation from local forest communities have helped the initiative expand remarkably. By 2023, the number of tiger reserves had grown to more than fifty, and India became home to over seventy percent of the world's wild tiger population. Experts emphasise that protecting tigers also safeguards entire ecosystems, because healthy tiger habitats secure vital river catchments and diverse wildlife species.

questions.text: Why do experts believe that protecting tigers also helps safeguard entire ecosystems?
questions.optionA: Because tigers prevent forest fires during summer
questions.optionB: Because healthy tiger habitats secure vital river catchments and diverse wildlife
questions.optionC: Because tiger reserves stop all rainfall in nearby towns
questions.optionD: Because tigers reduce the need for scientific research
questions.explanation: The last sentence states that healthy tiger habitats secure vital river catchments and diverse wildlife species.
